rule: mark_legacy_pair_fee_reviews counts and invalidates only candidates whose validation reports legacy_pair_fee_allocation_review_required, not every reviewed_residual:network_fee candidate.
Affected books lose their processing markers, gain an input version and require semantics version 7 together with the audit.
The decision reads the component validator's legacy_pair_fee_allocation_review_required issue.
Deleted legacy reviews become authored, activated and immediately superseded components before pairs and payouts migrate.
Active legacy direct payouts become activated conversion components.
A deleted review's component is superseded at the row's deletion time, not the migration clock.
A payout's physical source quantity is max(0, reviewed source).
A stored REAL payout value hashes and is retained as format(value, '.17g').
format(value, '.17g') writes fixed notation for decimal exponents -4 to 16.
Migration issues record the legacy table of the failed row (pairs or payouts).
parse_legacy_timestamp accepts RFC 2822 payout times when ISO parsing fails.
The payout term stores the canonical UTC payout time.
normalize_economic_terms refuses a payout value whose value per reviewed BTC is outside the supported price range.

find: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM transaction_pairs p JOIN transactions o ON o.id=p.out_transaction_id JOIN wallets ow ON ow.id=o.wallet_id JOIN transactions i ON i.id=p.in_transaction_id JOIN wallets iw ON iw.id=i.wallet_id WHERE p.component_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custody_authored_migration_issues m WHERE m.legacy_table='transaction_pairs' AND m.legacy_source_id=p.id AND m.resolved_at IS NULL)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM direct_swap_payouts p JOIN transactions o ON o.id=p.out_transaction_id JOIN wallets ow ON ow.id=o.wallet_id WHERE p.component_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custody_authored_migration_issues m WHERE m.legacy_table='direct_swap_payouts' AND m.legacy_source_id=p.id AND m.resolved_at IS NULL));
replace: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM transaction_pairs WHERE component_id IS NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM direct_swap_payouts WHERE component_id IS NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custody_authored_migration_issues WHERE resolved_at IS NULL);
rule: Admission accepts legacy rows held by an unresolved migration issue, as Python opens them.
The consolidation commits as one transaction: an interruption leaves none of its writes.
An exactly matched componentless dismissal gains its boundary relations and completeness header.
Recovery requires the full candidate fingerprint, not only the gap id; a changed candidate stays unscoped.
